Helper: `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs` — `imported_session_id(harness: HarnessKind, id: &str) -> String`.

OMP handling:

- In `imported_session_id`, `HarnessKind::Omp` uses the supplied `id` unchanged.
- The returned session ID is then `format!("{}_{}", harness.as_str(), id)`.
- Source: `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs`, `imported_session_id`.
- Verified by `test_import_omp_transcript` in `crates/cw-harnesses/src/lib.rs`:

```rust
assert_eq!(sess_id, "omp_01a16530-b4a1-71cb-b159-96200fb07f14");
```

Non-OMP handling:

- For any non-OMP harness, `imported_session_id` truncates `id` to its first 12 characters:

```rust
id.char_indices()
    .nth(12)
    .map(|(byte_offset, _)| &id[..byte_offset])
    .unwrap_or(id)
```

- If `id` has more than 12 characters, only the first 12 characters are kept.
- If `id` has 12 or fewer characters, `id` is kept unchanged.
- The returned session ID is then `format!("{}_{}", harness.as_str(), id)`.
- Source: `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs`, `imported_session_id`.

Prefix evidence for non-OMP is supported by `test_import_opencode_sqlite_db` in `crates/cw-harnesses/src/lib.rs`:

```rust
assert_eq!(imported[0], "opencode_ses_test_123");
```

That test confirms the `opencode_` prefix, but it does not prove truncation because `ses_test_123` is already 12 characters. Exact `harness.as_str()` values for other non-OMP harnesses are not directly supported by the supplied source; unverified.

Additional directly supported behavior: `import_generic_jsonl_transcript` in `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs` converts `HarnessKind::Pi` to `HarnessKind::Omp` when the path contains `/.omp/`, so that path uses OMP session ID handling.
